Overview

Kautuka Web Tools retrieves pages, converts them into markdown, and prepares evidence for agent workflows.

The first version is intentionally narrow and uses structure-aware chunking with character-based limits.

Retrieval

Lexical ranking should find the smallest relevant child chunks before bounded context expansion is applied.

This keeps the retrieval surface precise while preserving enough local context for coherence and citation.

Limits

Character counts control chunk sizing. Token estimates are advisory metadata only.

Hard limits include response bytes, normalized markdown characters, redirect cap, and chunk count.
